examples.question_text:
Find the expected value, variance and standard deviation of $X$. Give the standard deviation correct to two decimal places.

| $x$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X=x)$ | $0.2$ | $0.3$ | $0.5$ |

Use $\mathrm{Var}(X)=\sum(x-\mu)^{2}P(x)$ to find the variance of $X$. Check using $E(X^{2})-\mu^{2}$, then find the standard deviation correct to two decimal places.

| $x$ | $2$ | $5$ | $8$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X=x)$ | $0.2$ | $0.6$ | $0.2$ |

The probability function of $X$ is $P(X=x)=k(x+1)$ for $x\in\{1,2,3\}$. Find $k$, the expected value, the variance and the standard deviation. Give exact values and round the standard deviation to two decimal places.

The random variable $X$ has mean $0.9$ and the distribution below. Find $a$ and $b$, then calculate the variance and standard deviation. Give the standard deviation correct to two decimal places.

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X=x)$ | $a$ | $b$ | $0.25$ |
examples.solution_text:
Use the total probability and the given mean.

$\begin{aligned} a+b+0.25&=1\\ a+b&=0.75 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} 0a+b+2(0.25)&=0.9\\ b&=0.4\\ a&=0.35 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} E(X^{2})&=0^{2}(0.35)+1^{2}(0.4)+2^{2}(0.25)\\ &=1.4 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(X)&=1.4-0.9^{2}\\ &=0.59 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} \sigma&=\sqrt{0.59}\\ &\approx0.77 \end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
The numbers of rejects per shift for two machines are represented by $P$ and $Q$. Both have mean $2$. Calculate their variances and identify the less consistent machine.

| Outcome | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Probability for $P$ | $0.2$ | $0.6$ | $0.2$ |
| Probability for $Q$ | $0.35$ | $0.3$ | $0.35$ |
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{aligned} E(P^{2})&=0^{2}(0.2)+2^{2}(0.6)+4^{2}(0.2)\\ &=5.6 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(P)&=5.6-2^{2}\\ &=1.6 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} E(Q^{2})&=0^{2}(0.35)+2^{2}(0.3)+4^{2}(0.35)\\ &=6.8 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(Q)&=6.8-2^{2}\\ &=2.8 \end{aligned}$

Machine Q is less consistent because its variance is greater. More of its probability lies away from the common mean.

examples.question_text:
These probability distributions are reflections of each other. Calculate their variances and explain why they are equal.

| Outcome | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Probability for $V$ | $0.5$ | $0.3$ | $0.2$ |
| Probability for $W$ | $0.2$ | $0.3$ | $0.5$ |
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{aligned} E(V)&=0(0.5)+1(0.3)+2(0.2)\\ &=0.7 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} E(V^{2})&=0^{2}(0.5)+1^{2}(0.3)+2^{2}(0.2)\\ &=1.1 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(V)&=1.1-0.7^{2}\\ &=0.61 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} E(W)&=0(0.2)+1(0.3)+2(0.5)\\ &=1.3 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} E(W^{2})&=0^{2}(0.2)+1^{2}(0.3)+2^{2}(0.5)\\ &=2.3 \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(W)&=2.3-1.3^{2}\\ &=0.61 \end{aligned}$

Reflection preserves each distance from the corresponding mean and its probability, so the weighted squared distances and variances are equal.

examples.derivation: Probabilities sum to 1. Independently calculated μ=-0.2+1=0.8 and E(X²)=0.2+2=2.2. Variance=2.2-0.64=1.56; standard deviation=√1.56≈1.25. Matches the source's second-moment method and negative-outcome exercises.

μ=0.4+3+1.6=5. Deviations are -3, 0, 3; weighted squared deviations are 1.8, 0, 1.8, giving variance 3.6. Independently, E(X²)=0.8+15+12.8=28.6 and 28.6-25=3.6. Standard deviation≈1.90. Both methods follow the source scaffolds.

Normalization gives 9k=1, so k=1/9 and probabilities are 2/9, 3/9, 4/9. μ=(2+6+12)/9=20/9; E(X²)=(2+12+36)/9=50/9. Variance=450/81-400/81=50/81; standard deviation=√50/9≈0.79. Matches the source's probability-rule and normalization tasks.

Total probability gives a+b=0.75. The supplied mean gives b+0.5=0.9, hence b=0.4 and a=0.35. E(X²)=0.4+1=1.4; variance=1.4-0.81=0.59; standard deviation≈0.77. Uses the source's total-probability and supplied-mean method before calculating spread.

Both distributions have mean 2. E(P²)=2.4+3.2=5.6 and E(Q²)=1.2+5.6=6.8. Their variances are 1.6 and 2.8 respectively, so machine Q is less consistent. Matches the source's spread comparisons and contextual consistency interpretation.

E(V)=0.7 and E(V²)=1.1, giving variance 0.61. E(W)=1.3 and E(W²)=2.3, giving variance 0.61. Reflection pairs each outcome v with 2-v, preserving its probability and squared distance from the corresponding mean. Matches the source's reflection explanation.
